def range_compress(ints):
    if not ints:
        return []
    sorted_unique = sorted(set(ints))
    result = []
    i = 0
    n = len(sorted_unique)
    while i < n:
        start = sorted_unique[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and sorted_unique[j] == sorted_unique[j - 1] + 1:
            j += 1
        end = sorted_unique[j - 1]
        if end > start:
            result.append([start, end])
        else:
            result.append([start])
        i = j
    return result
